The question asks about csv.DictReader behavior when fieldnames is omitted vs explicitly provided, and whether fieldnames order is preserved.

Looking at span 60: "The fieldnames parameter is a sequence. If fieldnames is omitted, the values in the first row of file f will be used as the fieldnames and will be omitted from the results. If fieldnames is provided, they will be used and the first row will be included in the results. Regardless of how the fieldnames are determined, the dictionary preserves their original ordering."

This directly answers all parts of the question:
1. When fieldnames is omitted: first row values are used as fieldnames and omitted from results
2. When fieldnames is provided: they are used and the first row is included in results
3. Fieldnames order is preserved: "the dictionary preserves their original ordering"

I can cite span 60 for all of these claims.
